title: Audit conditional CRT last-K two-slice streaming tariff
body:
This audits the elementary last-K branch in Cinna Davis’s PR4100 CRT.md §4: conditional on the uniform evaluator, complete omitted suffix and paid ordinary width-one callee, a fixed-tape two-slice schedule prepares once per complete prefix fiber and costs O(VK) for at most K targets. It makes ownership, cleanup, head returns and full workspace explicit. The original exchange/control/amortization mechanism remains credited to PR4100; PR4174’s reservoir context and PR4169’s complementary repair retain credit.

For M=2^L records, the schedule uses exactly M/2^(H+1) preparations. The exact 13V invoice covers middle-stage payload read/write/head actions only; evaluator/counters/markers, ordinary exchanges and private intermediate cleanup are separately charged. The finite CRT fixture is a source-bound root-axis control projection with suffix-only transport, not full three-reservoir placement or a production tail instance.

Validation: six registered Python3.12 commands, ordinary and optimized, passed. Primary:4,328 control/layout cases and252,060 dirty-address endpoints; retained-source projection:4,096 dirty addresses/seven layers; separate implementation:2,164 cases/1,209,888 address columns; source-pinned one-bit payload control:15,016 cases/119,440 records. Semantic/admission/tariff mutants are detected. Exact source pins and source-history/committed-byte checks pass. Local paths in public review receipts are replaced by portable labels; raw receipts are retained locally.

Remaining obligations: actual uniform E evaluator/tariff, ordinary callee and owned-return contract, full production placement/exception classification, compact repair integration, precision and complete CRT/multiplication theorem. No new κ or selected-frontier change. New code/proof Apache-2.0, ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; separate-agent review is not independent human review or formal-kernel acceptance.

Canonical main refreshed before submission:12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244, priority7. All306 open/draft PR bodies plus current handoffs and focused last-K Discussion search checked; broader Discussion/closed coverage partial. Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4173#discussioncomment-19070026

Reproduce:
```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/crt-last-k-streaming --check-only
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/crt-last-k-streaming
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/crt-last-k-streaming --check-source-history
```

Maintainer edits disabled. No merge requested.
